    $\text{Christine} \to \text{Patrick}$

From (2), (5), (4), (6), and (1):
$\text{Joshua} \to \text{Christine} \to \text{Patrick} \to \text{Ethan} \to \text{Benjamin} \to \text{Kenneth}$

$\text{Terry} \to \text{Madison} \to \text{Kenneth}$
